scope: Prevent the AC1021+ TABLE parser from interpreting empirically observed, undocumented cell types with the known R2007 text/block layout; preserve the existing anonymous-block fallback.

sourceEvidence.relevantFinding: ODA §20.4.96.1 says R2008 changed cell data but leaves the details unresolved; no semantics are assigned here to the observed unknown types.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: These are observations from one local sample and reader revision, not universal mappings or portable type-code declarations.

change.behavior: For versions newer than AC1018, only cell types 1 and 2 use the current text/block parser. Other types log an unsupported-type diagnostic, append an incomplete subrecord range, return incomplete semantic parsing, and leave the enclosing TABLE's anonymous *T block projection available.

cases.expected: no guessed contents; semantic parsing incomplete; incomplete subrecord recorded; cursor stops at cell common-prefix end
text cell and literal integer CadValue parse completely; data cursor ends before separate string stream
block reference, scale, and CadValue parse completely

generatedParserVectors.sameObjectRetry: After type 16 is refused, the same DRW_Table instance parses the supported type-1 and type-2 vectors, verifying state reset.
generatedParserVectors.wireConstruction: The table body, cells, value/string stream and sentinels are generated in memory from literal field writes; no DWG/DXF fixture is written. The shared common entity prefix uses the existing production encoder.

observed: R2007 TABLE cell parse incomplete; anonymous block insert kept

localSmoke.interpretation: The TABLE semantic parser now stops at the unknown cell types. The unrelated whole-file FIELD/FIELDLIST export preflight still prevents a qualified DXF result, so this run does not validate TABLE serialization.

notes: The name matcher selected a broad sample/output-version matrix.
A sampled AC1024 case failed at the existing LAYOUT last-active viewport owner export preflight.
AC1021 failures also reported reader-integrity mismatches; aggregate results do not establish regression attribution for this TABLE guard.
focusedCtestRun.qualification: Not a passing regression gate. Isolate representative failures against a pre-slice baseline or parser-only controls before drawing causal conclusions.

nextStep: Trace AC1021 cell types 16 and 92 against ODA §§20.4.96–20.4.101 and an independently implemented parser or producer witness. Keep unknown types fail-closed unless exact field order is corroborated; qualify AC1024+ embedded TABLECONTENT separately.
